generator_metadata.summary: An 8..30 rectangular maze has one start(2), one goal(3), a complete gray wall barrier(8), one to three paired portals colored 4/5/6, and up to eight extra walls. Start and goal lie on opposite sides and no ordinary route crosses the barrier; at least one portal pair is required.

review_brief:
# Review — b87dcd3011b1

- Repaired the canonical paired-portal generator and kept the exact canonical Racket program as the default.
- Made five controls strict and live across lawful 8×8 through 30×30 scenes; portals are now semantically necessary.
- Restored exact canonical profile anchors in every difficulty band and broadened semantic validation to all supplied authority examples.
- Built the native `portal_policy = all_pairs | widest_pair_only` family with matched inputs, 3–6 demos, and 1–4 queries.
- The alternate rule derives the greatest-Manhattan-span portal color, then uses only that pair during BFS.
- Added a protected-Racket wrong-intermediate witness: selected color 5 versus forced color 4 produces a different final grid.
- Repaired an initial three-demo teaching hole exposed by horizontal-span, nearest-goal, and scan-order shortcuts.
- Final selector audit: 96 episodes, 15 rivals, no survivors or query failures; finite evidence only.
- Final source review also found and fixed one-shot iterator miscounting in the reusable adversarial tool.
- Current task suite: 30/30 passing; strict override matrix: 11,880/11,880; semantic gate: 600/600.
- Native authoring preflight: 4 jobs, 28 parametric pairs, 4 canonical pairs, 40 protected-Racket evaluations.
- Public export checks passed for 16 single-query views, 24 first-turn invariance checks, and four positive controls.
- Four deliberate export/source-binding corruptions were rejected while the unmodified bundle was accepted.
- Reviewer-ready only: owner source review, fresh qualification/acceptance, and training admission remain pending.
- Whole-source final review was self-review because no independent reviewer tool was available.

previous_catalog_record.summary: Start (color 2), goal (color 3), 0-3 walls (color 8), optional portal pairs.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived active portal color selected by step A; for the chosen qualified case it is color 5, with spans {4: 18, 5: 20, 6: 13}.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find portal colors 4, 5, and 6 that occur exactly twice; compute each pair's Manhattan endpoint separation; select the unique greatest separation, breaking any tie by lower color.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Run cardinal-neighbor breadth-first search from color 2 to color 3. Only entering the selected active portal pair teleports to its mate; other portal colors are ordinary traversable cells. Paint background cells on the recovered route color 7.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected color changes the BFS successor graph: it determines which two locations are joined by a teleport edge. Substituting color 4 for the selected color 5 changes the reachable shortest route and therefore the final painted output.

parametric_work.summary: Canonical all-pairs teleportation and input-derived widest-pair-only teleportation are implemented as matched native lessons with three-demo qualification, four distinct queries, protected Racket labels, and a wrong-intermediate causal witness. Reviewer-ready; owner qualification and acceptance are pending.
